title: ARPANET initial nodes operational
before: Computers were mostly isolated or connected via specialized, non-packet networks.
problem: Researchers needed resource sharing across distant machines.
change: The US Department of Defense commissioned ARPANET; IEEE timeline notes the first four nodes becoming operational at UCLA, UC Santa Barbara, SRI, and Utah in 1969 using packet switches.
whyItMattered: Packet networking proved a scalable approach that informed later internet architecture.
enabled: Inter-network research leading toward today's Internet.
concreteExample: Email and remote login research traffic on early packet networks foreshadowed everyday internet services.
caveat: ARPANET is an ancestor of the Internet, not identical to the modern global Internet with commercial ISPs and the Web.
